parent_observation.role: frozen mechanism/PIT/cost/first-hit/PASS rules; six-asset diagnostic only

purpose: 在冻结 P0 机制假设下，用全市场 derived 15m→4h/1h 重跑无条件 4H SMA7 延续性 kill test；不是调参，不是策略版本。

identity_boundaries.sma42_4h_role: seven-day clock-equivalent control only, never a replacement or selector for SMA7

data.funding_timestamp_normalization: date_trunc('second', ts) before selected symbol-ts de-duplication; resolves millisecond archive offsets for the same nominal funding time without changing the funding schedule
data.duplicate_policy: fail on duplicate selected symbol-ts rows
fail_closed_conditions: FULL_MARKET coverage gate failure on derived 4h or 1h
critical OHLCV or funding identity nulls
non-positive OHLC price or illegal OHLC interval
missing, duplicate, non-consecutive, unclosed, or illegal 1h component inside a phase-shifted 4h bar
data after cutoff entering event or outcome calculation
funding missing for a fixed-horizon net-return window
PIT membership requiring future volume or static current Top N

universe.contract_exists_and_tradable_at_event: observed complete derived 4h bars with standard Binance perp identity
universe.adv_formula: mean daily quote_volume over the 30 UTC days strictly before the event day, using derived 4h quote_volume only
universe.coverage_formula: sum complete 4h bars over the 30 UTC days strictly before the event day divided by 30 * 6
universe.pool_ranking: descending trailing ADV with deterministic symbol tiebreaker

excluded_underlyings.source: explicit frozen exclusion list used by newer all-market MA7 research because the older 15m EMAX inventory CSV is not present in this checkout

aggregation_4h.native_0h_formula: accepted 15m complete-bucket resample; 16 consecutive closed legal 15m bars; ohlcv_resample_from_15m_v1
aggregation_4h.phase_1_2_3_source: binance.perp.ohlcv.1h.from_15m.v1 via catalog dataset_id, then P0 4-consecutive-1h aggregation
aggregation_4h.phase_shift_formula: open=first 1h open; high=max 1h high; low=min 1h low; close=last 1h close; volume, quote_volume, trade_count and taker fields=sum
aggregation_4h.phase_component_requirement: exactly four consecutive closed legal 1h bars per shifted 4h bar

indicators.atr_formula: ATR20[t] = arithmetic mean(TR[t-19:t]) over complete 4h bars

events.equality_assignment: equality belongs to the pre-cross side; only strict post-cross triggers

first_hit.intrabar_order_source: future real 1h high/low in chronological order from 1h.from_15m.v1

outcomes.fixed_horizon_exit_price: open at entry boundary plus horizon 4h bars

costs.funding: real funding events over (entry_ts, exit_ts] signed by direction; missing funding blocks net and tradeability claims

same_side_non_cross.method: deterministic stratified weighting, not random single-point sampling
same_side_non_cross.eligibility: same symbol/year/side, close already on the corresponding SMA side at signal time, and no same-direction strict cross on that bar
same_side_non_cross.atr_quintile: causal percentile of ATR20[t-1] within symbol history through t-1, bucketed into five right-closed bins
same_side_non_cross.weighting: non-cross rows are weighted so symbol x year x side x ATR quintile stratum weights match cross-event counts

statistics.multiple_testing: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR across side x horizon x MA control families
known_unfixed_blockers: complete calendar years are still counted only over 2023-2025 while PASS requires four positive years
horizon table cluster p_value overwrites bootstrap p_value of the same field name

supported_weak_continuation_all_required: MA7 +2ATR/-1ATR/30 first-hit favorable rate exceeds stratified same-side non-cross baseline
95% block-bootstrap CI lower bound of first-hit difference is above 0
30-bar executable full net directional return is above 0
at least four complete calendar years have positive full net directional return
not determined by one symbol, one year, or top 1% events
8bps/fill stress does not fully cross the cost wall
MA5/MA10 neighborhood does not give a fully opposite mechanism conclusion
decision_rules.partial_structural_separation: stable first-hit, MFE, or survival separation exists but net return, annual stability, cost, or concentration gates fail
decision_rules.no_go: no stable first-hit, fixed-horizon return, MFE, or survival advantage versus same-side control, or all advantage explained by costs/concentration/right tail
decision_rules.family_status_after_p0r_data: explore / diagnostic-only / not promoted / not live-ready
